name: Vespid Dynamics Paralytic Aerosol Grenade PAG-2 'Sleepy Time'
description: A throwable aerosol grenade that disperses Vespid's proprietary fast-acting paralytic compound over a 10-meter radius. The compound targets voluntary motor function while leaving autonomic systems intact — targets remain conscious and breathing but cannot move, speak, or resist for approximately fifteen minutes. The effect onset is 3-5 seconds after inhalation, making the window for donning respiratory protection extremely narrow. Vespid markets it as a humane incapacitation tool, though the psychological effect of being fully conscious but completely paralyzed has been documented as severely traumatic.
specifications:
dispersal radius: 10 meters in still air
onset time: 3-5 seconds after inhalation
effect duration: 12-18 minutes
aerodynamic delay: 2 seconds after pin pull
weight: 0.3 kg
compound persistence: 45 seconds airborne
countermeasure: Respiratory filtration prevents inhalation; no post-exposure antidote
story_hooks: PAG-2 grenades have been deployed in a series of robberies targeting augmented individuals — victims are paralyzed while their cyberware is surgically removed.
A contaminated batch of PAG-2 grenades has hit the market where the autonomic preservation fails in approximately 5% of exposures — meaning some victims stop breathing.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact spheroid grenade with a distinctly medical aesthetic — sleek and almost clinical in appearance, suggesting pharmaceutical precision rather than violence. The form is rounded and slightly asymmetrical, with a pronounced safety pin loop at the apex that catches light like a chrome accent.
physical_description.dimensions: 8.5 cm diameter, 9.2 cm height including safety pin loop. Compact enough to fit in a closed fist.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and well-balanced — sits comfortably in the palm without feeling insubstantial. The mass distribution creates an almost casual feel, belying its incapacitating function.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polycarbonate shell with internal aluminum dispersal chamber. Surface has a subtle frosted quality suggesting high-tech medical devices.
physical_description.finish: Matte clinical white with translucent frosted panels revealing faint internal mechanisms. Minimal weathering even on field-used units — designed for sterile appearance.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: clinical white with soft dove gray accents. Safety pin: brushed stainless steel. Subtle mint-green accent stripe near base with Vespid's molecular logo.
physical_description.grip_texture: Smooth polycarbonate with subtle grip ridges at equator. Feels almost like holding a high-end cosmetic container rather than a weapon.
distinctive_features: Transparent frosted windows on opposite sides revealing swirling liquid/aerosol matrix inside
Stainless steel pressure-release valve at base with microetch pressure gauge
Minimalist Vespid Dynamics logo — a stylized wasp silhouette in mint green
Four small venting ports arranged symmetrically around upper hemisphere
Safety pin with grooved grip and attached pull ring showing wear from field handling
Faint serial number laser-etched on base plate
No visible weathering or corrosion — suggests regular maintenance or short operational lifespan
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Vespid Dynamics logo centered at base. "PAG-2 'SLEEPY TIME'" printed in clean sans-serif on polar region. "USE AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY" in micro-text on safety collar. Tier-3 licensing mark (small circular stamp) near base.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly maintained. Field units show only minor surface scuffs and worn safety pin edges. Never appears truly battle-scarred — designed for clean deployment and quick effect rather than durability through punishment.
